title: concrete style apartment
content: Just wondered if anyone had a similar dream recently. I was in a big house or appt of a famous person. Think he was a chef. Bald head. white guy. The interior was on different levels and all grey smooth concrete style. Minimalist. Different outdoor spaces or gardens coming off certain rooms. Some hallways were unpractical and narrow. The out door spaces were surrounded by high walls I think. I cleaned his kitchen for him while he was out, not very exciting but it’s what I did for some reason. It was one of my extremely vivid and RL dreams so felt the need to share it xxx
